meta.name: A10 / CPE102 Grand Prix
meta.description: Viewbook of team A10 for KMUTT CPE102, told as a 16-round race season. One 3D car carries the page from the grid slot to the exploded view; the scroll is the only control.
source_references: the site itself, measured from screenshots at 1440x900 (hero, lap, exploded views)

color.palette_type: dark, near-monochrome with one red accent and a yellow signal

primary.role: ink: headlines and body text on the dark ground

accent.role: red as text or stroke on dark: the third headline line, counters, label numbers, leader dots

neutral.usage: lightest to darkest. #121418 is the page and the asphalt of the 3D track; #0b0d10 is the telemetry ground; text sits at the light end

color.contrast_strategy: every text pair at 4.5:1 or better: #eef1f4 on #121418 is 15.9:1, #a3aab3 on #121418 is 7.9:1, #ff3b30 on #121418 is 5.4:1, white on #c1121f is 6.0:1

measurement.sampling: design-dna measure-colors.mjs on the hero at 1440x900

font_families.heading: Kanit 800/900 italic
font_families.mono: JetBrains Mono, with Chakra Petch for telemetry headings

typography.font_style_notes: Thai first. Kanit Black Italic is the poster voice and is also the face painted on the car (A10). Mono only carries data: dates, round codes, timing rows, exploded-view kickers and notes.

spacing.content_density: open on the 3D screens (one idea per screen), dense in the timing sheet
spacing.section_rhythm: pinned screens of exactly one viewport, then free-scrolling data sections; a diagonal chequered seam between the two worlds

breakpoints.desktop: 1024px (pins for the calendar also need 700px of height)

layout.alignment_tendency: left-aligned words, the car on the right or below; label column on the right of an exploded view

border_radius.pill: 999px (only the round gantry lights and markers)

shape.border_usage: 1px hairlines in #2a2e35 on cards; 2px ink outlines on nav links; 6px ink rules between poster sections
shape.divider_style: solid rules and a 24px chequered strip

elevation.shadow_style: none on the interface; the 3D car has a baked contact shadow of its own footprint
elevation.depth_cues: surface steps (#121418 to #1a1d22), hairlines, and the real perspective of the track

iconography.style: none: numbers and type do the work

motion.easing: expo.out for entrances (signature), power3.inOut for clip reveals, none for anything tied to scroll; 3D easing is inOutCubic and outCubic applied inside the scene

duration_scale.macro: 600-900ms headline rise and counter roll; scroll-driven 3D has no duration

motion.entrance_pattern: rise 24px with fade, 60ms stagger, under 500ms in total; headlines rise out of a clipped baseline
motion.exit_pattern: the same move reversed when the section leaves upward
motion.philosophy: The scroll bar is the throttle. One car, one unbroken camera move, and nothing in 3D moves unless the scroll moved it. Archetype: energetic, tempered by rigid-metal rules for the machine (no overshoot).

components.button: skewed outline link, 44px tall, ink border, fills ink on hover in 150ms, presses 1px
components.input: photo slot: click or drop a picture, stored in the browser
components.card: calendar card: photo, dark shade under the title, opens wide when the race is at it
components.navigation: four anchor links in the header; scrolling is the only way through the content
components.list: timing rows in mono with a status column; exploded-view labels numbered 01 to 06 top to bottom
components.notes: label = number in red mono, part name in poster italic, note in mono; a 1.5px leader line from a red dot on the part

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a race weekend: grid, lights out, timing sheet, parc ferme
aesthetic.era_influence: motorsport posters and broadcast timing graphics
aesthetic.genre: scroll-driven showpiece for a course viewbook

design_style.visual_language: heavy italic type over real 3D: grained asphalt, red and white kerbs, a chequered start line, rubber laid at the start. Chrome stays flat and quiet so the car carries the colour.
design_style.composition: the headline lies over the car, which is as big as the screen (across a wide one, up an upright one), under a shade that ends where the words end; after that words left, machine right: side-on at speed, three-quarter on the stand
design_style.imagery: one F1 car with every real brand mark removed and the team's A10 painted on; a steering wheel model (CC BY) for the driver roll call, with the page's own dash on its screen; the team's own photos per round
design_style.interaction_feel: scrubbing a film: every frame is a function of scroll, forwards and backwards
design_style.brand_voice_in_ui: Thai, plain, short; English only for round titles and race terms

overview.effect_intensity: high on five pinned screens, none elsewhere
overview.fallback_strategy: no WebGL or prefers-reduced-motion: no stage, sections in normal flow, a still of the exploded car with a plain numbered list and every note written out, no roll call
overview.primary_technology: three.js 0.181 (plain, loaded after first paint), GSAP 3.15 ScrollTrigger, Lenis

background_effects.notes: the page colour is the asphalt; nothing decorative behind content

3d_elements.renderer: one fixed WebGLRenderer behind the page, alpha, DPR capped near four million pixels, drawn only when the scroll state changes
3d_elements.lighting: RoomEnvironment through PMREM, key and rim directional lights; for the steering wheel the room is turned, with a back kicker and one close lamp
3d_elements.camera: one perspective camera described as azimuth, elevation and metres across the screen; long lenses (18 to 26 degrees)
3d_elements.materials: lacquered red paint with clearcoat, matt rubber, satin carbon; decals on a polygon offset
3d_elements.geometry: car 183k triangles, meshopt-compressed GLB with WebP textures; steering wheel 104k triangles, the same compression

shader_effects.notes: one ground shader: asphalt grain from a tileable texture, chequered start line, kerbs, tyre marks, speed streaks; antialiased with fwidth; screen-space keep-outs that follow the text

trigger_points: hero pin: words lift off the car, five lights, launch
13/16 pin: one lap of the camera
calendar pin: horizontal run, car under the open card
driver roll call pin: the wheel turns into a corner for each driver
scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: pinned, scrubbed camera and model state
scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: scrub 0.5 to 0.6 seconds of smoothing; progress equals scroll

text_effects.notes: headline lines rise from a clipped baseline and float off the car on scroll; the 13/16 counter rolls digit columns; exploded-view notes type themselves out, one grapheme at a time, when a label is pointed at

image_effects.notes: cover photo reveals with a clip-path wipe; calendar photos zoom 3% on hover

canvas_drawings.notes: the steering wheel's dash is drawn on a canvas from the site's own data (rounds done, drivers)

svg_animations.notes: leader lines of the exploded view draw out from the part; the KMUTT track draws with DrawSVG

visual_effects.composite_notes: 3D sits behind the DOM at z-index 0. Sections are either solid (they wipe the car away) or clear (the car shows through). No glow, no purple, no blur.
